# Delete confirmation returns a decision and can disable the active warning

`confirmDelete()` reads the first selected header's folder if no folder was passed. It chooses only one enabled warning in order: deleting from Trash, operating on a collapsed thread, permanent deletion outside Trash, then news deletion. The collapsed-thread comparison uses view selection count versus selected-message count, so it can include hidden thread messages. Each warning has its own preference and exact bundle key.

Without an enabled warning it returns true. Otherwise it prompts in the most recent window. A nonzero response returns false before any preference write. An accepted response returns true; if Don't Ask Again was checked, it writes false only to the selected warning preference. It does not itself delete a message.

The checked `cmd_deleteMessage` and `cmd_shiftDeleteMessage` callers forward to the parent command when embedded in about:3pane. Otherwise they stop on false, update next-message selection, and issue the appropriate view command for Trash deletion or permanent deletion. Native view deletion, Undo, and actual folder storage are downstream dynamic targets; their bodies were not fully reviewed here.

Direct browser tests verify warning text, cancellation preserving the selected message, confirmation deleting it, and deletion when each warning preference is disabled. They also check focus in the message pane for a shift-delete case. They do not directly check overlapping warning precedence or every Don't Ask Again write. Those gaps are narrower than the existence of this broad test file. Only the relevant test sections were read; no browser pass is claimed.

## Evidence

- [mail/modules/MailUtils.sys.mjs:1066–1140](https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/blob/87d0159c7149a43253964c2cb6917939557dc799/mail/modules/MailUtils.sys.mjs#L1066-L1140): `confirmDelete`.
- [mail/base/content/mailCommon.js:286–310](https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/blob/87d0159c7149a43253964c2cb6917939557dc799/mail/base/content/mailCommon.js#L286-L310): `delete and shift-delete callers`.
- [mail/test/browser/folder-display/browser_messageCommands.js:487–666](https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/blob/87d0159c7149a43253964c2cb6917939557dc799/mail/test/browser/folder-display/browser_messageCommands.js#L487-L666): `warning and deletion assertions`.

## Validation and limits

The source was read from the pinned Git revision. Source facts, caller contracts, and test assertions were checked together. No product test result is claimed by this note. Dynamic targets and possible failures named above remain explicit. This note adds behavior evidence to the existing structural maps; it does not establish a project rule or complete analysis of the component. Suite was excluded.
